description: Shared correctness fixtures for the five decoder variants (copyingDecoder, objectBuildingDecoder, validatedZeroCopyView, lazyFieldDecode, mutableInPlaceUpdate) over three datasets. Decoding strategy changes ns/message, B/message, bytes copied and validation cost, never the checksum.

semantics.xorshift64: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 7 (unsigned/logical); x ^= x << 17 (64-bit wrapping, unsigned interpretation throughout)
semantics.wireFormat: big-endian (network byte order) throughout: every frame is msgType(1B) + seq(4B BE u32) + a dataset-specific length/count field(4B BE u32) + payload(variable). mutableInPlaceUpdate writes original XOR 0xFFFFFFFF into a fixed field, reads it back to verify the write, then writes the original value back before proceeding — the buffer is unchanged after the round trip, so its checksum matches the other four (read-only) variants exactly.

fixedHeaderPlusVariablePayload.fields: msgType = i % 4; seq = i; payloadWords = [4,8,16,32][i % 4]; payload = payloadWords longs, xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000 each
fixedHeaderPlusVariablePayload.checksum: wrapping sum of (msgType + seq + sum(payload)) over all messages

nestedRepeatedFields.fields: msgType = i % 4; seq = i; recordCount = [2,4,8][i % 3]; records = recordCount (id, amount) pairs, id = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000, amount = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 10,000,000 — one advance each, id then amount, per record
nestedRepeatedFields.checksum: wrapping sum of (msgType + seq + sum(id + amount) over every record) over all messages

utf8Field.fields: msgType = i % 4; seq = i; textLen = [8,16,32,64][i % 4]; text = textLen bytes, each = 0x20 + (xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 95) — guaranteed printable ASCII, therefore always valid UTF-8, one advance per byte
utf8Field.checksum: wrapping sum of (msgType + seq + sum(byte values in text)) over all messages
